title: The Simply Schedule Appointments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The Simply Schedule Appointments WordPress plugin contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'payment_method' parameter affecting all versions up to and including 1.6.13.4. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when an administrator visits a specific hidden support page and triggers a particular action. Exploitation requires an administrator to perform the 'Fix appointment durations' action, which the attacker can influence by manipulating the 'start_date' field to create a persistent duration mismatch. The vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping.
